sentences.en: Generally speaking, distance runners are less flexible than sprinters.
sentences.zh: 一般来说，长跑运动员比短跑运动员的身体柔韧性差。

sentences.en: Usain Bolt is the fastest sprinter in Olympic history.
sentences.zh: 乌塞恩·博尔特是奥运历史上最快的短跑运动员。

sentences.en: The young sprinter won gold at the national championships last week.
sentences.zh: 那个年轻的短跑运动员上周在全国锦标赛上获得了金牌。

senses.zh: 短跑运动员，短距离全速奔跑者
